data.name: Skill unlock diplomacy 10 Ranks
data.description: You can attempt to adjust a creature's attitude in 1 round by taking a -10 penalty. If you take 1 minute to adjust a creature's attitude, add your Charisma bonus to the number of hours that attitude change persists.
